caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, possibly a towel or cloth, laid flat. The upper portion consists of a light beige or off-white fabric featuring subtle floral patterns and geometric designs, rendered in a muted tone close to the background color. Four vertical red lines and two horizontal red lines form a rectangular grid near the object's right edge, intersecting slightly above the horizontal center. Below the grid, a broad horizontal band of intricate red embroidery or woven pattern runs across the textile. This red band contains floral motifs on the left side and a geometric star-like figure on the right, set against a red background with white detailing. Two thinner horizontal red lines run parallel to the broad red band, one above and one below it. The lower portion of the textile terminates in evenly spaced, white fringe tassels. The overall composition uses primarily off-white and red colors, with shading to suggest folds and fabric texture.
title: Linen Towel - Flower Design
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
